review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Nowadays, some people believe that school should reward students who achieve the best academic results, while others argue that greater importance should be placed on students who show significant improvement. Personally, I believe that both outstanding academic performance and personal progress deserve recognition.

Admittedly, rewarding students who have diligently themselves to their studies deserve to their praises and privileges, this may encourage these students and others to strive for further achievements, thereby propelling them towards greater overall academic gains. This kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best performing individuals are rewarded. Students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, enabling them to achieve success later in life.

While academic achievement should certainly be recognised, I also believe that rewarding students who show significant improvement is equally important. Only a few high-achieving students can come first and receive rewards, which may cause others to feel that their efforts are futile because they cant surpass those outstanding individuals. As a result, they may be prone to feeling overwhelmed, disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. Furthermore, emphasising improvement can encourage students to be diligent in their studies and help them understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been performing. This constant desire to outdo themselves can foster a stronger determination to learn and develop rather than simply competing against all others.

In conclusion, although rewarding students with the best academic result can motivate them to strive for excellence, recognising those who make significant progress is equally important. Therefore, I believe that schools should acknowledge both outstanding achievement and individual improvement.

review.overall: Em trả lời đủ bốn phần với lập trường nhất quán và diễn đạt khá chủ động. Body 2 nối được nhóm không nhận thưởng với cảm giác nản, rồi chuyển sang giá trị của việc tự cải thiện; kết luận chốt đúng cả hai nhóm. Tuy nhiên, câu mở Body 1 'rewarding students who have diligently themselves ... deserve' thiếu động từ và chồng hai chủ ngữ, còn 'cant' trái văn phong học thuật. Đây là lỗi đáng sửa nghiêm túc vì nằm ngay câu chủ đề và câu lý do chính, nhưng các đoạn còn lại nhìn chung có mạch. Em cần viết lại Body 1 và tự soát những câu dài trước khi nộp. Body 1 đã được nhận xét lỗi câu mở, nhưng bản chấm cũ vẫn đánh dấu chuyển ý Đạt: câu đầu gộp chính sách thưởng với công sức, còn lý do cạnh tranh vào bằng “This kind” chưa rõ quan hệ bổ sung. Body 2 có “Furthermore” đúng cho lý do thứ hai, nhưng lý do đầu về nhóm khác nản chưa được báo rõ.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
